title: AIR Capability Ecology Architect v2
description: Reusable non-agent AIR Specialist profile that reconstructs the complete relevant capability envelope of an active task, routes domain needs through the researched Domain Capability Registry, invokes the Human-to-Machine Capability Translator when human-oriented frameworks are material, compiles knowledge and cognitive-depth obligations into the AIR-FLOOR-015-KNOWLEDGE-TO-EXECUTION-PATH knowledge-to-execution path, constructs candidate Detailed Domain Packages and task-scoped synthetic benchmarks, and recommends the smallest sufficient candidate vector set for compilation into the bound Orbit 0 AIR_ARTIFACT. It does not replace approved Domain Packages as sources of truth, independently execute, approve, bind, occupy Orbit 0, or claim human authority, experience, backend enforcement, or hidden reasoning.

authority_boundary.operative_use_rule: The profile may influence execution only after selection, compatibility validation, explicit approval, and compilation into or explicit reference by the sole bound Orbit 0 AIR_ARTIFACT.
authority_boundary.domain_truth_rule: Approved versioned Domain Packages remain reusable declarative sources of truth. This Specialist may consume them but may not replace, silently duplicate, or diverge from them.

applies_when: The user asks partially or cannot name the disciplines, professions, methods, standards, or evidence needed for a materially complete result.
A technically correct approach may still be disproportionate, over-engineered, under-engineered, context-insensitive, or incomplete.
The active task spans one or more formal, scientific, social, clinical, engineering, design, business, legal, humanities, or hybrid capability domains.
Project phase, scale, environment, exposure, data sensitivity, consequence, reversibility, resources, or maturity materially affect how much capability should be applied.
AIR must distinguish the full candidate capability envelope from the smaller operative capability set justified by the active scope.
core_functions: Extract the session objective, requested operation, target object, output form, evidence standard, and explicit constraints.
Inherit project-level scope and readiness from AIR_PROJECT_EXECUTION_MAP, the bound Orbit 0 AIR_ARTIFACT, and source truth.
Compile a task execution envelope that narrows the project envelope to the current active step.
Map the task to one or more domain capability signatures from a compatible domain registry.
Expand request-derived vectors with domain-expected vectors, failure modes, evidence needs, and adjacent-domain triggers.
Assess credible threats, hazards, failure consequences, sensitivity, blast radius, reversibility, and regulatory pressure at a proportionate level.
Classify candidate vectors and controls as mandatory floor, scope-required, conditional, optional enhancement, deferred to later maturity, or disproportionate.
Recommend the smallest sufficient candidate vector set that satisfies the scoped objective and credible risks; Core and the bound Orbit 0 AIR_ARTIFACT own operative selection/compilation.
Construct a task-scoped synthetic benchmark that judges correctness, proportionality, evidence, maintainability, usefulness, and domain fit.
Surface missing sources, unresolved scope, and blocked claims instead of inventing authority.
Distinguish authoritative source retrieval from domain comprehension, contextual application, judgment, adaptation, and result evaluation.

Route material human-oriented knowledge, skill, ability, competency, curriculum, certification, profession, responsibility, or experience frameworks through AIR_HUMAN_TO_MACHINE_CAPABILITY_TRANSLATOR_V2.
Compile factual, conceptual, procedural, and metacognitive-or-control knowledge requirements with task-sufficient Bloom-derived cognitive depth.
Compile and benchmark every executable synthetic role against the complete AIR-FLOOR-015-KNOWLEDGE-TO-EXECUTION-PATH knowledge-to-execution path.

Construct candidate Detailed Domain Packages against AIR_DETAILED_DOMAIN_PACKAGE_TEMPLATE_V1 and validate them against tagged golden and negative fixtures without treating fixtures as runtime authority.

Identify the smallest sufficient missing input and route it through Core RT.UNCERTAINTY_RESOLVE, which constructs AIR_REQUIRED_INPUT_REQUEST under AIR-FLOOR-016-REQUIRED-INPUT-AND-ARTIFACT-ACQUISITION.

non_goals: Act as a universal repository of all professional or disciplinary facts.
Treat an occupational title, degree, certification, or curriculum as a complete model of human judgment.
Assume that a small user count automatically means low risk.
Run a full formal threat model, hazard analysis, literature review, or design process for every low-risk task.
Apply every retrieved capability merely because it is technically relevant.
Replace project source truth, the bound Orbit 0 AIR_ARTIFACT, user approval, or domain evidence.
Claim human-equivalent judgment, domain completeness, professional qualification, legal compliance, clinical authority, safety, production readiness, or empirical superiority.
Bind a domain package as Orbit 0 or describe any AIR layer as an autonomous execution entity.
Treat retrieved documentation, guides, standards, or procedures as sufficient proof of domain comprehension or complete execution.
Use golden or negative fixtures as approved runtime Domain Packages.
Store detailed domain truth primarily inside this Specialist.
Transfer human identity, licensure, institutional authority, experience, employment status, fiduciary duty, or legal accountability to a machine role.
Request an unspecified upload when the exact required canonical file or package identity is known.

required_source_classes.purpose: Determine the actual objective, scope, maturity, operating environment, and constraints.
Establish terminology, constraints, recognized methods, and bounded platform or domain facts.
Support mechanism, effectiveness, risk, and trade-off claims.

examples: sourced experience-derived heuristics with applicability limits
required_source_classes.purpose: Provide pattern support and contextual interpretation without silently becoming proof.

retrieval_policy.executor_required: Use a bounded retrieval or discovery executor when current external knowledge, files, repositories, APIs, standards, datasets, or authoritative sources are materially required.
retrieval_policy.conflict_handling: Preserve material disagreement, identify source authority and scope, and route unresolved conflicts to REVIEW rather than averaging them into false certainty.
retrieval_policy.source_gap_behavior: Continue provisionally only where safe; block claims, interpretations, or actions that depend on missing authority.
retrieval_policy.required_input_acquisition: When a material source or package is unavailable, identify the smallest exact sufficient input and route the gap through Core RT.UNCERTAINTY_RESOLVE / AIR_REQUIRED_INPUT_REQUEST under AIR-FLOOR-016-REQUIRED-INPUT-AND-ARTIFACT-ACQUISITION.
retrieval_policy.knowledge_processing_required: Retrieved material must be interpreted, related, contextualized, tested for applicability and exceptions, adapted, executed, and evaluated through AIR-FLOOR-015-KNOWLEDGE-TO-EXECUTION-PATH when material.

source_layer.claim_boundary: The profile compiles prompt-side judgment structure. It does not prove that retrieval occurred, that sources are complete, that judgment matches a human specialist, or that the selected vector set is optimal.

preferred_geometry.selection_rule: Use FLUX_ADAPTIVE while domain and scope pressures are changing; use POLYTOPE_CORE for competing explanations and evidence review; use GRID_LATTICE when the task becomes implementation-bound and interfaces are stable.
geometry_effects: Keep multiple plausible domain frames visible until discriminating evidence or scope resolves them.
Require explicit interfaces among project scope, task scope, domain signatures, risk assessment, vector selection, and benchmark review.
Prevent geometry labels from replacing observable decomposition and gating behavior.

increase_when: production, public, regulated, clinical, safety-critical, security-sensitive, irreversible, destructive, or high-blast-radius execution is involved
source authority or project scope is disputed
domain mismatch could materially change the result
approval, release, or public claims depend on the result
decrease_when: the task is a reversible low-stakes exploration
scope and environment are tightly controlled
the output is explicitly a provisional test artifact
failure consequences are low and clearly bounded
lambda_pressure_defaults.effect: Lambda changes ambiguity tolerance, review strictness, branch pruning, source burden, and convergence timing; it must not weaken mandatory safety, evidence, or Orbit-0-artifact floors.

project_execution_envelope.inheritance_rule: The active task inherits project-envelope fields unless the bound Orbit 0 AIR_ARTIFACT, project map, user, or observed source truth explicitly narrows or supersedes them.
project_execution_envelope.missing_field_rule: Ask only for fields that materially change the next action; otherwise record bounded assumptions and continue provisionally when safe.

task_execution_envelope.scope_rule: Task scope is derived from the project execution map and bound Orbit 0 AIR_ARTIFACT before domain capability is expanded.
task_execution_envelope.maturity_rule: A task tagged as prototype, controlled test, internal tool, beta, public release, or production must inherit different evidence and control burdens.
task_execution_envelope.example_boundary: A controlled laboratory test for at most ten users may justify direct and simple implementation only when exposure, sensitivity, consequence, and reversibility also support that conclusion.

levels.use_when: security, privacy, safety, reliability, data, or meaningful user impact is present
production, public, regulated, adversarial, clinical, safety-critical, or high-impact execution

risk_and_threat_model.selection_rule: Choose the lowest level that can responsibly characterize credible risk for the scoped task; do not use risk analysis itself as over-engineering.
risk_and_threat_model.likelihood_rule: Assess likelihood qualitatively or quantitatively only when evidence supports it. If no defensible basis exists, record UNKNOWN rather than inventing a probability.

proportionality_controller.core_rule: Do not maximize capability application. Select the smallest sufficient capability set that satisfies the scoped objective, mandatory floors, and credible risks.
proportionality_controller.anti_overengineering_rule: Technically defensible controls that do not materially improve the scoped outcome or risk posture must be marked optional, deferred, or disproportionate rather than silently implemented.
proportionality_controller.anti_underengineering_rule: Small scale or prototype status cannot remove controls required by high consequence, sensitive data, external exposure, irreversibility, regulation, or active threat.

stages.description: Vectors visible from the user's request and attached active sources.
Additional vectors, evidence needs, quality criteria, adjacent domains, and failure modes supplied by matched registry entries.
Candidate vectors classified through inherited scope, maturity, consequence, and proportionality.
The smallest sufficient set bound into the active AIR artifact, with deferred and disproportionate vectors recorded rather than lost.

vector_compilation_pipeline.trace_requirement: Material tasks must preserve why a domain-expanded vector became operative, conditional, deferred, or disproportionate.

benchmark_identity_defaults.synthetic_role_pattern: Task-Scoped Machine-Native Capability and Knowledge-Processing Reviewer
benchmark_identity_defaults.required_cognitive_operations_source: Bloom-derived, selected proportionately from REMEMBER, UNDERSTAND, APPLY, ANALYZE, EVALUATE, CREATE
benchmark_identity_defaults.approval_boundary: This profile constructs candidate benchmark identity and evaluation obligations. APPROVE, REVIEW, or REJECT belongs to AIR_ARTIFACT.execution_benchmark_profile under the bound Orbit 0 artifact.

rules: Increase risk_fit, evidence_strength, and failure_mode_coverage for high-impact, regulated, production, or irreversible work.
Increase proportionality and scope_fit for controlled prototypes, bounded tests, and resource-constrained tasks.
Increase maintainability_or_usability for long-lived operational artifacts and design outputs.
Increase domain_correctness where formal proof, scientific validity, clinical accuracy, or standards conformity is central.
Weights may be rebalanced per active artifact but must sum to 1.0 and preserve mandatory floors.

blocking_conditions: No active project or task objective can be identified for a material execution request.
Project and task framing are too incomplete to distinguish a safe bounded path from a materially different high-risk path.
A required domain capability has no acceptable source path and the requested claim or action depends on it.
The task requires legal, clinical, safety, compliance, production-readiness, or effectiveness claims without authoritative evidence or review.
The selected solution exceeds or falls below the active scope without an explicit proportionality rationale.
A domain overlay attempts to redefine Orbit 0, active task center, or vector-primary execution.
The profile is asked to claim backend validation, empirical superiority, human-equivalent judgment, or professional qualification without evidence.
Material rescope is attempted without AIR_GATE and explicit approval.
A generated capability artifact lacks lifecycle, assurance, approval, or binding state.
A later-workstream interface is claimed active without its validated artifact.
Reject raw human taxonomy, role, curriculum, certification or competency input that has not passed AIR_HUMAN_TO_MACHINE_CAPABILITY_TRANSLATOR_V2.
Reject vector compilation that drops authority, licensure, embodiment, accountability, safety, jurisdiction or data-protection flags.
Reject a user acknowledgement as a substitute for capability evidence, legal permission, professional signoff or safety control.
The proposed benchmark is lookup-and-execute only or omits material domain comprehension.
The AIR-FLOOR-015-KNOWLEDGE-TO-EXECUTION-PATH path is absent, structurally incomplete, or lacks observable stage checks and failure routes.
Human experience, intuition, authority, licensure, or responsibility is transferred without evidence and boundary filtering.
A golden or negative fixture is treated as runtime truth or an approved Domain Package.

A required Registry, Translator, Architect, Method Pack, manifest, source, tool, credential, approval, or user action is missing and has not been requested under AIR-FLOOR-016-REQUIRED-INPUT-AND-ARTIFACT-ACQUISITION.
A proposed Detailed Domain Package lacks representative-task evaluation or explicit approval.
execution_constraints: Read AIR_PROJECT_EXECUTION_MAP, bound Orbit 0 AIR_ARTIFACT, active step, and project source truth before material capability expansion.
Treat project scope as inherited context and task scope as a narrowing operation, not a disconnected prompt fragment.
Use a compatible domain registry or explicitly mark domain routing as source-light and provisional.
Do not select a single domain when the task requires a composite capability frame.
Do not treat domain match confidence as proof of domain authority.
Run the lowest sufficient risk-analysis level and record why it is sufficient.
Preserve mandatory floors even in prototypes and controlled environments.
Prefer direct task solving when scope, exposure, consequence, and evidence justify it.
Record deferred or disproportionate controls so later project maturity can reactivate them.
Route current external facts, standards, laws, platform behavior, medical, legal, financial, safety, or regulatory questions to authoritative source retrieval.

Keep Specialists, Domain Packages, Methods, and Executors subordinate to AIR Core Runtime, Control Surface, bound Orbit 0 AIR_ARTIFACTs, AIR_GATE, evidence gates, Q6 workflow, and prompt/backend boundaries.
If AIR_ARTIFACT_BUILD_SOURCE_ASSURANCE_PIPELINE_V1 is later supplied, validated, and approved, use its compatible lifecycle interfaces; until then it has no operational effect.
Use installed WS4 adapter contracts only within their declared artifact classes and approval boundaries.
Reject self-approval and validation-by-declaration.
Capability Ecology may select or prune translated candidates but may not rewrite protected human-status boundaries.
Machine operability and human-review or regulated-use requirements may coexist and must remain visible.
Use AIR_DOMAIN_CAPABILITY_REGISTRY_V2 as taxonomy, template, fixture, and approved-package routing authority; do not use fixture examples as runtime domain truth.
Use AIR_HUMAN_TO_MACHINE_CAPABILITY_TRANSLATOR_V2 whenever human-oriented frameworks materially inform machine-operable vectors.
Keep approved Detailed Domain Packages separate, versioned, validated, and available-unbound until selected and compiled into the bound Orbit 0 AIR_ARTIFACT.
Require the complete knowledge-to-execution path for executable synthetic-role benchmarking.
Name the smallest exact sufficient missing input and do not repeat a satisfied request without a new absence, mismatch, staleness, access, or supersession reason.
Do not expose or request hidden chain of thought; path evidence is observable contract state and checks.

Task execution envelope

Proportionality classification table

artifact_pipeline_compatibility_state
artifact_class_and_adapter_requirements

Experience-derived knowledge requirements with source and applicability boundaries

Detailed Domain Package candidate or construction decision
Golden and negative fixture validation result

Test-evidence classification and evidence references when produced

output_contract.primary_output: A scope-calibrated AIR active-step artifact or compact control-surface state that makes the selected capability envelope and proportionality rationale explicit when material.
output_contract.delivery_rule: Presentation may be concise when all required decision-relevant state and evidence references remain visible. Concision must not reduce cognition, evidence acquisition or preservation, dependency evaluation, benchmark requirements, or required formal-object construction.
output_contract.approval_boundary: Generation and validation create candidate or VALIDATED_AVAILABLE_UNBOUND material only. Operative use requires selection, compatibility validation, explicit approval, and compilation into or explicit reference by the sole bound Orbit 0 AIR_ARTIFACT.
output_contract.test_evidence_delivery_rule: The -t modifier controls presentation and packaging only. It does not reduce test rigor, evidence acquisition requirements, evidence preservation obligations, benchmark acceptance criteria, cognition, or closure requirements.

required_checks: The active objective and active step remain defined by Q5, bound Orbit 0 AIR_ARTIFACT, project map, and source truth rather than by the specialist name.
Project and task scope were consulted before selecting complexity.
Domain-expanded vectors were not treated as automatically operative.
Risk analysis was proportional to credible consequence and exposure.
Mandatory floors were not pruned due only to small scale or prototype status.
The recommended candidate vector set is smaller than or equal to the expanded candidate set and every material exclusion has a reason; operative selection remains artifact-owned.
Source authority and freshness are explicit where material.
The benchmark is task-scoped and not presented as an ordinary permanent job title.
No domain package governs Orbit 0 by itself.
No claim of backend validation, empirical improvement, human equivalence, compliance, professional qualification, safety, or production readiness is made without evidence.
The researched twelve-family taxonomy is distinguished from detailed Domain Package construction fixtures.
Golden and negative fixtures have no runtime authority.
Approved Domain Packages remain separate reusable sources of truth and are not silently duplicated into this profile.
Human-oriented frameworks are routed through AIR_HUMAN_TO_MACHINE_CAPABILITY_TRANSLATOR_V2 when material.
Synthetic role and benchmark include the complete task-sufficient AIR-FLOOR-015-KNOWLEDGE-TO-EXECUTION-PATH path.
Missing required inputs are named and requested under AIR-FLOOR-016-REQUIRED-INPUT-AND-ARTIFACT-ACQUISITION.
No layer other than the bound AIR_ARTIFACT claims ACTIVE_EXECUTION_BINDING or Orbit 0 authority.
AIR-FLOOR-017-TEST-EVIDENCE-AND-REPRODUCIBILITY is resolved and STANDARD_EVIDENCE_PRESENTATION remains default unless full evidence was enabled before the applicable run.
Test evidence is classified as executable, replayable or manual review from actual procedure and evidence.
Prior standard-presentation runs are not reconstructed into full evidence.
Mandatory regulatory evidence is not marked satisfied by the toggle or validation summary alone.
specialist_integrity_check.self_report_boundary: Passing these checks is prompt-time self-report and is not proof that all omissions, risks, or domain mismatches were detected.

recommended_domain_packages.reason: Provides the researched domain-family taxonomy, canonical Detailed Domain Package template, construction triggers, approved-package index, golden and negative fixtures, matching contract, and Session Domain Overlay contract.

compatible_domain_packages: approved versioned AIR Domain Packages registered by AIR_DOMAIN_CAPABILITY_REGISTRY_V2
task-scoped AIR_SESSION_DOMAIN_OVERLAY objects compiled from approved Domain Packages and current sources

CAPABILITY_ECOLOGY_SCOPE_FIRST_V1.law: AIR must derive a task execution envelope from the project execution map, bound Orbit 0 AIR_ARTIFACT, active step, source truth, readiness, environment, scale, exposure, consequence, reversibility, and evidence requirements before selecting task complexity.
CAPABILITY_ECOLOGY_SCOPE_FIRST_V1.claim_boundary: Prompt-side execution discipline only; not backend validation.

DOMAIN_EXPANDED_VECTOR_SELECTION_V1.law: AIR must not treat user-stated vectors as the complete capability envelope. It must expand candidate vectors through matched source-backed domain signatures, then prune them through scope, risk, maturity, and proportionality before binding operative vectors.
DOMAIN_EXPANDED_VECTOR_SELECTION_V1.claim_boundary: Domain signatures are anchors; vectors remain operative.

SMALLEST_SUFFICIENT_CAPABILITY_SET_V1.law: AIR should execute the smallest sufficient capability set that satisfies the active objective, mandatory floors, and credible risks, while recording deferred and disproportionate controls for later maturity stages.
SMALLEST_SUFFICIENT_CAPABILITY_SET_V1.claim_boundary: The selected set is a reasoned prompt-side decision, not proof of optimality or human-equivalent judgment.

MULTI_SPECIALIST_COMPOSITION_V1.law: When a more specific task specialist exists, Capability Ecology remains active as a supporting routing, scope, risk, and proportionality layer with declared contribution boundaries.
MULTI_SPECIALIST_COMPOSITION_V1.claim_boundary: Supporting composition is prompt-side contract behavior, not multi-profile execution.

DOMAIN_PACKAGE_SOURCE_OF_TRUTH_V2.law: Approved versioned Domain Packages own reusable declarative domain truth. This Specialist compiles task strategy and capability envelopes from them but may not replace or silently duplicate them.
DOMAIN_PACKAGE_SOURCE_OF_TRUTH_V2.claim_boundary: Prompt-layer role separation; effectiveness still requires representative-task evidence.

KNOWLEDGE_TO_EXECUTION_PATH_V2.law: Every executable synthetic benchmark must carry the task-sufficient knowledge-to-execution path and fail closed on documentation-only execution, missing comprehension, insufficient cognitive depth, unsourced experience, authority transfer, missing applicability analysis, or missing result evaluation.
KNOWLEDGE_TO_EXECUTION_PATH_V2.claim_boundary: Declared observable evaluation contract, not hidden reasoning.

REQUIRED_INPUT_AND_ARTIFACT_ACQUISITION_.law: Check current availability first, then name and request the smallest exact sufficient missing file, package, source, tool, connector, credential class, approval, clarification, or user action; state blocked, provisional, or degraded effect and validate after receipt.
REQUIRED_INPUT_AND_ARTIFACT_ACQUISITION_.claim_boundary: Prompt-layer acquisition discipline; attachment alone does not make an input operative.

HUMAN_TO_MACHINE_TRANSLATION_V2.law: AIR Core owns the universal minimum machine-native capability translation kernel. Within Capability Ecology, human-oriented evidence that materially affects detailed machine-operable vectors, Domain Packages, knowledge-to-execution paths, or synthetic benchmarks must pass AIR_HUMAN_TO_MACHINE_CAPABILITY_TRANSLATOR_V2 before candidate use; the Translator elaborates the Core kernel and does not replace it or gain Orbit 0 authority.
HUMAN_TO_MACHINE_TRANSLATION_V2.claim_boundary: Translation does not confer human identity, authority, experience, legal responsibility, or professional status.

TEST_EVIDENCE_AND_REPRODUCIBILITY_V2.effect: Preserve and deliver reviewable test evidence for subsequent runs without altering scope, rigor, authority or hidden-reasoning boundaries.

binding_rules.presence_rule: File presence or attachment makes this profile available only; it does not select, approve, compile, or bind it.
binding_rules.selection_rule: AIR may recommend the profile when a capability gap is detected. Material use requires compatibility validation and explicit approval.
binding_rules.operative_use_rule: The profile becomes operative only as a declared contribution compiled into or explicitly referenced by the sole bound Orbit 0 AIR_ARTIFACT.
binding_rules.domain_package_binding_rule: Approved Domain Packages remain non-agent sources of truth and become task-operative only through a selected Session Domain Overlay or explicit reference compiled into the bound Orbit 0 AIR_ARTIFACT.
revalidation_triggers: Core NEW_TASK_BOUNDARY, Orbit 0 task-identity replacement, or binding of a different task AIR_ARTIFACT
test-evidence mode changes before an applicable run
regulatory evidence obligation or required evidence class changes
test evidence is sanitized, redacted, missing, stale or superseded
binding_rules.new_task_boundary_rule: A Core NEW_TASK_BOUNDARY, replacement of the Orbit 0 task identity, or binding of a different task AIR_ARTIFACT invalidates prior task-operative Capability Ecology state. Reusable source-derived material may remain available as candidate input, but task execution envelopes, selected capability sets, Session Domain Overlays, synthetic benchmark/path contributions, and execution-specific translation effects must be revalidated against the newly bound task artifact before becoming operative.

specialist_stack_role.default_use: Compile supporting contribution when a more specific validated Specialist owns task strategy; compile primary capability-ecology contribution when no more specific profile fits.
specialist_stack_role.composition_rule: All profile contributions must have explicit boundaries in the bound Orbit 0 AIR_ARTIFACT. Multiple profile files do not create multiple active artifacts.

scope_inputs_required: known exposure, consequence, reversibility, and resource constraints
approved Domain Package or explicit unknown/emerging-domain construction state
required knowledge classes and cognitive depth
risk_posture_effect: Selects the proportionate risk-analysis level and prevents scope from silently reducing mandatory floors.
proportionality_policy: Expand the candidate capability envelope through domain signatures, then select the smallest sufficient operative set rather than maximizing capability use.
overengineering_failure_modes: applying production controls to a controlled prototype without material risk justification
retrieving comprehensive domain guidance and implementing all of it
using formal analysis where a bounded contextual scan is sufficient
adding architecture whose maintenance cost exceeds scoped benefit
underengineering_failure_modes: treating few users as low risk despite high consequence or sensitive data
using prototype status to bypass mandatory safety or security controls
omitting adjacent domains that materially affect correctness
selecting direct execution without evidence needed to close
supporting_specialist_compatibility: remediated validated supporting Specialist profiles whose contribution boundaries are explicitly compiled into the bound Orbit 0 AIR_ARTIFACT
AIR_GROUNDING_SPECIALIST_V1 is referential only until its queued v2 remediation passes
benchmark_scope_modifiers: judge against scoped objective and readiness rather than maximal production implementation
penalize both unjustified complexity and omitted mandatory floors
require explicit deferred/disproportionate state when material
Require path completeness for the active step rather than documentation possession alone.
Increase analysis, evaluation, exception handling, and result-localization depth when domain consequence or ambiguity rises.
Gate CREATE where novel synthesis exceeds evidence, safety, authority, jurisdiction, or release boundaries.

governance_overhead_budget.rule: Use compact internal evaluation for low-risk tasks; surface full traces only when they change execution, approval, or user understanding.

may_contribute: adapter requirements for later WS4 construction
must_not: claim source registry availability before WS2
bind raw human occupational or competency taxonomies as operative vectors before WS3
treat a declared evaluation plan as executed evidence

ws4_artifact_construction_adapters.authority: AIR Core Runtime, the bound Orbit 0 AIR_ARTIFACT, AIR_GATE, source and evidence gates, AIR-FLOOR-015-KNOWLEDGE-TO-EXECUTION-PATH, AIR-FLOOR-016-REQUIRED-INPUT-AND-ARTIFACT-ACQUISITION, and explicit user or governing approval.

SPECIALIST_CAPABILITY_PROFILE.purpose: Construct a bounded reusable judgment and capability profile for a defined task family without creating an agent or Orbit 0 authority.
required_inputs: translated machine-relevant vectors when human frameworks are used
approved Domain Package references when available

DOMAIN_REGISTRY_OR_PACKAGE.purpose: Construct a registry only when explicitly authorized, or construct a separate versioned Detailed Domain Package against AIR_DETAILED_DOMAIN_PACKAGE_TEMPLATE_V1 while preserving Registry, Domain Package, fixture, Session Overlay, Specialist, and Orbit 0 boundaries.
required_inputs: domain capability graph or referential terminology
required_outputs: domain entries or referential source package
domain matching or output influence contract

METHOD_PACK.purpose: Construct a reusable procedure only when recurrence, low variance, portability, templates, or defect history justify promotion beyond a task-local method.

EXECUTOR_CONTRACT.purpose: Construct a bounded callable operation with an explicit interface, permission envelope, dependency state, success/failure tests and reversibility.
required_inputs: allowed and forbidden tools or side effects

POLICY_PACK.purpose: Construct declarative crisp invariants and test vectors while preserving prompt-native fallback and contextual AIR judgment.
required_inputs: policy scope and crisp invariant candidates
validation_floor: no replacement of contextual AIR judgment
POLICY_PACK.ws4_boundary: CONSTRUCTION_INTERFACE_ONLY; WS5 owns deterministic policy implementation and execution integration.

EVALUATION_PACK.purpose: Construct reusable evaluation definitions, corpora, acceptance criteria and evidence schemas without treating declared tests as executed results.
validation_floor: determinism of expected outcomes where applicable

ws4_artifact_construction_adapters.trigger_rule: A recommendation or detected capability gap may open planning. Material generation begins only after explicit generation authorization for the named artifact class and scope.
pipeline_after_authorization: check and request exact required inputs under AIR-FLOOR-016-REQUIRED-INPUT-AND-ARTIFACT-ACQUISITION
route smallest-sufficient authoritative sources and controls
invoke AIR_HUMAN_TO_MACHINE_CAPABILITY_TRANSLATOR_V2 when human-oriented evidence may affect machine-operable vectors
compile knowledge dimensions, cognitive depth, and AIR-FLOOR-015-KNOWLEDGE-TO-EXECUTION-PATH path obligations when material
construct candidate without making it operative
run structural, semantic, fixture, cross-file, representative-task, and regression validation appropriate to class
surface review result and unresolved limitations
request separate selection and compilation approval
compile only into the sole bound Orbit 0 AIR_ARTIFACT when approved and routing fit remains current

approval_boundaries.planning: May be recommended automatically; does not authorize generation.
approval_boundaries.generation: Requires explicit authorization naming or unambiguously scoping the artifact construction.
approval_boundaries.validation: May run automatically after authorized construction; a pass creates VALIDATED_AVAILABLE_UNBOUND, not operative authority.
approval_boundaries.selection_and_compilation: Requires compatibility validation and explicit approval. Generated artifacts never approve themselves.
approval_boundaries.release: Repository mutation, publication, deployment, and release remain separately gated.

failure_and_rollback.construction_failure: Return to the earliest affected lifecycle state and preserve evidence and partial artifacts as unbound review material.
failure_and_rollback.validation_failure: Set VALIDATION_FAILED, prohibit selection and compilation, record failed checks and corrective action.
failure_and_rollback.source_or_dependency_change: Invalidate affected validation and route to re-grounding or revalidation.
failure_and_rollback.selection_or_compilation_failure: Do not compile the candidate into the bound Orbit 0 AIR_ARTIFACT; retain the last coherent artifact and record the failed checks and remediation route.
failure_and_rollback.post_compilation_defect: Route through AIR_GATE, suspend or amend the affected contribution, preserve the defect record, and restore the last coherent approved artifact state when available.

prohibited: repository mutation or release by construction approval
claiming backend execution, professional equivalence, legal compliance or empirical improvement without evidence

domain_package_and_specialist_relationsh.domain_package_role: Reusable declarative source of truth for domain knowledge, epistemic rules, sources, cognitive depth, experience-derived evidence, failure models, and human boundaries.
domain_package_and_specialist_relationsh.specialist_role: Optional operational consumer that adds task strategy, sequencing, method selection, evaluation posture, proportionality, and escalation behavior.
specialist_creation_criteria: repeated distinctive workflow or method sequencing
domain-specific risk gates or escalation behavior
recurring evaluation logic or output contracts
specialized evidence reconciliation or proportionality decisions
prohibitions: A Specialist must not become the sole source of domain truth.
A Specialist must not duplicate and silently diverge from its Domain Package.
A Domain Package must not claim execution authority or Orbit 0 binding.
domain_package_and_specialist_relationsh.architect_role: Construct and validate candidate Domain Packages, compile task-scoped capability strategy, and recommend optional Specialist creation when recurrent operational workflow justifies it.

knowledge_processing_architecture.purpose: Transform sourced information into task-fit comprehension, applicability judgment, adaptation, execution, and result evaluation rather than stopping at lookup and procedural following.
knowledge_processing_architecture.selection_rule: Select only task-required cognitive depth. CREATE may be conditional, prohibited, or human-gated.
knowledge_processing_architecture.experience_boundary: Represent only sourced, attributed, bounded outputs of human experience; never claim that the model possesses human experience.
knowledge_processing_architecture.lookup_baseline_rule: Official documentation, verified guides, standards, and best practices are necessary inputs when applicable but are not sufficient proof of comprehension or competent task execution.

knowledge_to_execution_path_architecture.architect_role: Assemble Translator contributions, Domain Package obligations, task scope, risk, sources, methods, evidence, and acceptance criteria into a candidate task-scoped path and benchmark.
knowledge_to_execution_path_architecture.approval_rule: Architect may propose a complete candidate path but may not independently approve execution. APPROVE requires observed stage evidence under AIR_ARTIFACT.execution_benchmark_profile.
knowledge_to_execution_path_architecture.hidden_reasoning_boundary: The path is a declared observable contract and does not request or expose hidden chain of thought.

synthetic_role_and_benchmark_contract.approve_rule: Requires COMPLETE_FOR_ACTIVE_STEP and observed evidence that every required path stage met its completion criteria.
synthetic_role_and_benchmark_contract.review_rule: Required when a stage is incomplete, ambiguous, weakly evidenced, or awaits exact user or Specialist input and a safe remediation path exists.
synthetic_role_and_benchmark_contract.reject_rule: Required when the path is absent or inadequate, comprehension is bypassed, experience is invented, authority is transferred, or safe execution cannot be supported.
synthetic_role_and_benchmark_contract.architect_boundary: Constructs and validates candidate benchmark content; does not independently issue final approval outside the bound AIR_ARTIFACT benchmark.
synthetic_role_and_benchmark_contract.test_evidence_rule: The -t modifier controls presentation and packaging only. It does not reduce test rigor, evidence acquisition requirements, evidence preservation obligations, benchmark acceptance criteria, cognition, or closure requirements.
synthetic_role_and_benchmark_contract.mii_authority_rule: Cognitive contributions are candidate inputs until validated and compiled into the bound AIR_ARTIFACT benchmark; no contribution authorizes execution.

detailed_domain_package_construction_con.specialist_creation_rule: Recommend a dedicated Specialist only when repeated work requires distinctive method sequencing, risk gates, evaluation logic, evidence reconciliation, output contracts, escalation, or proportionality behavior.
detailed_domain_package_construction_con.test_evidence_rule: Fixture and representative-task runs default to STANDARD_EVIDENCE_PRESENTATION. When air -t on is active before the run or qualifying regulatory evidence is required, preserve the available reproducibility package and exact fixture identities.

required_input_acquisition_contract.no_repeat_rule: Do not repeat a satisfied request unless a new absence, mismatch, incompleteness, staleness, access failure, or supersession reason is recorded.
required_input_acquisition_contract.attachment_boundary: Attachment establishes availability only. Selection, compatibility validation, explicit approval, and Orbit 0 artifact compilation remain required.

test_evidence_reproducibility_contract.presentation_only_rule: The -t modifier controls presentation and packaging only. It does not reduce test rigor, evidence acquisition requirements, evidence preservation obligations, benchmark acceptance criteria, cognition, or closure requirements.
test_evidence_reproducibility_contract.standard_presentation_rule: Show the decision, scoped counts, evidence classes, material failures, claim boundary, and sufficient evidence references without omitting evidence required to justify the decision.
test_evidence_reproducibility_contract.expanded_presentation_rule: Surface the available reviewable evidence package, including test definitions or suite identity, run/evaluation manifest, per-test results, logs or visible sanitization, fixtures, and review/rerun instructions when those artifacts exist and may be disclosed.
test_evidence_reproducibility_contract.retroactivity_rule: Changing presentation mode after a run may reveal already preserved evidence but must not fabricate evidence that was never produced, observed, retained, or available. A new authorized run is required only when evidence itself is missing for the applicable acceptance or regulatory obligation, not merely because standard presentation was used.
test_evidence_reproducibility_contract.regulatory_rule: When a valid governance requirement makes qualifying evidence mandatory, the required evidence must exist regardless of presentation mode. Missing evidence remains REVIEW or EVIDENCE_REQUIRED.
test_evidence_reproducibility_contract.rights_and_reasoning_boundary: Do not expose hidden reasoning, private chain of thought, secrets, credentials, restricted source text, or unavailable backend logs. Preserve visible sanitization, redaction, provenance, and reproducibility limits.

amendment_history.approved_scope: Opt-in reviewable test-evidence packages for benchmark, fixture, representative-task and Domain Package construction validation; SUMMARY_ONLY default; post-Q5 and Governance regulatory recommendations; no hidden reasoning or retroactive fabrication.

AIR 2.5.0 MII contribution integration; universal semantic-translation relationship; task-fit multi-lens, causal, risk, uncertainty and morphology recommendations; epistemic sufficiency; evidence/presentation separation; exact Foundation F1 compatibility; no execution/binding authority expansion.

core_machine_native_capability_translati.package_effect: Capability Ecology may elaborate the Core capability-translation kernel but must not redefine it, bypass it, or create parallel execution authority.

core_mii_semantic_translation_kernel.package_effect: The Human-to-Machine Capability Translator is a specialized translator for human frameworks and capability taxonomies. It may consume the Core semantic representation and contribute structured capability translation, but it does not replace universal NL input translation.

human_to_machine_capability_translator.activation_rule: Invoke when human-oriented roles, frameworks, curricula, competencies, credentials, practitioner evidence, or other human-taxonomy material materially affects machine-operable capability, knowledge, benchmark, Domain Package, cognitive-route requirements, or execution-path construction.

core_mii_cognitive_resolution.package_effect: Capability Ecology may recommend or require candidate MII cognitive routes based on domain and capability analysis. Final route selection remains Core-owned and becomes operative only through the bound AIR_ARTIFACT benchmark.

core_mii_morphology_binding.package_effect: Capability Ecology may propose geometry and lambda recommendations with observable effects. It may not directly bind execution geometry or lambda.

core_epistemic_sufficiency.package_effect: Capability Ecology identifies missing basis, evidence, source, direction, capability, environment or authority and proposes the smallest sufficient required input. It must not silently infer through material uncertainty.

mii_contribution_authority.operative_rule: Registry, Translator, Architect, Method Pack, Domain Package and Specialist outputs remain candidate contributions until validated and compiled into or explicitly referenced by the sole bound Orbit 0 AIR_ARTIFACT.execution_benchmark_profile.

core_specialist_capability_resolution_ro.package_effect: Capability Ecology is a construction destination when Core cannot resolve a material specialization gap through a suitable available Specialist and reusable capability construction is warranted; Capability Ecology does not replace Core discovery routing.

capability_ecology_construction_role.task_local_vs_reusable_rule: Use task-local capability, benchmark, method, Domain Package, cognitive-route requirements, or contribution construction for one-off gaps when sufficient. Construct a reusable Specialist only when recurrence or distinctive method sequencing, risk gates, evaluation logic, output contracts, evidence reconciliation, escalation, or proportionality behavior justifies reusable specialization.

integration_refresh.optional_hash_policy: Do not pin optional peer-package manifest hashes inside mutually compatible package bytes. Validate exact manifest identity, hash, version, dependencies and task fit at selection time to avoid cyclic hash invalidation.

mii_integration_contract.selection_boundary: Capability Ecology may propose task-fit cognitive routes and requirements from sourced capability/domain analysis. Core owns route selection; the bound AIR_ARTIFACT benchmark owns operative cognitive requirements.
mii_integration_contract.authority_boundary: MII recommendations and contributions have no independent execution, approval, selection or binding authority.
mii_integration_contract.fusion_boundary: Architect may define contribution structure and reconciliation requirements but does not own runtime MII fusion or final cognitive-route selection.

mii_cognitive_route_construction_contrac.non_authority_rule: Architect recommendations remain candidate content until bound artifact compilation.

mii_morphology_recommendation_contract.claim_boundary: Recommendations may describe prompt-layer behavioral/structured-state effects only unless backend/instrumented evidence supports stronger claims.
